title: Courtyard that is the only daylight source to a habitable room is uncovered and at least 4m2
text: Windows and openings (applies to R50-R80; R100-SL; LR, MR, and HR only). C2.2.1 Where a courtyard is the only source of daylight to a habitable room, the courtyard must be uncovered and open to the sky(1) with a: i. minimum area of 4m2 (refer Figure 2.2a). (1) Excludes minor projections

replaces.note: openable window 10% of floor area deleted (NCC duplication), register ch2-018
bathroom openable window deleted, register ch2-018

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Heading 'Windows and openings (applies to R50-R80; R100-SL; LR, MR, and HR only)'; merit criteria M2.2.1-M2.2.3 carry no density qualifier (register ch2-021). Clause has an 'i.' with no 'ii.'; Figure 2.2a still captioned '(multiple dwellings)'. 'Open to the sky' excludes minor projections (footnote 1).

verified.note: Figure 2.2a also annotates 'Min dimension = 0.5 x wall height'; this is in the figure only, not the clause, and is not encoded.
